message.content:
This is a HarfBuzz vulnerability. The crash is in `AAT::KerxSubTableFormat1<AAT::KerxSubTableHeader>::driver_context_t::transition` and `AAT::StateTableDriver<AAT::ExtendedTypes, AAT::Format1Entry<true>::EntryData>::transition`. This is an MSAN (uninitialized memory read) issue in the kerx table (AAT kerning) processing.

Let me look at the relevant source files.
